synthesizedInputs: Report-completion pass: the original stardust:audit run captured all raw probes but crashed before Phase 6 synthesis. This audit.json was synthesized from the on-disk probes without re-crawling the live site (behind PerimeterX bot protection). Brand surface was read from _brand-probe.json + per-page style blocks + the index page iris design-token customProps, rather than a Phase-1 _brand-extraction.json (not produced by the crashed run).

assumptions: Report-completion pass: this audit was synthesized from pre-captured on-disk probes after the original run crashed before synthesis. The live site was not re-crawled (PerimeterX / HUMAN Security bot protection).
Primary conversion action assumed to be 'start or continue a contact-lens order' — the orange (#f36b00) button is the repeated primary CTA (9x on the home page), routing to /lenses and /reorder.

Representative mobile CWV run assumed to be 'home-mobile-v2' (status 200, full 198-resource load). The status-403 mobile runs in _cwv.json are PerimeterX bot-challenge stubs (13 resources / 22 DOM nodes) and were excluded as non-representative.
brandColorShare was measured on the captured flash-sale home screenshot; the orange share is elevated by the promotional hero and promo bands present at capture time.

altCoverage was aggregated from the per-page SEO-probe counts; the probe's generic-alt heuristic did not flag some 'media image' / 'callout image' strings visible in the home page JSON, so true meaningful-alt coverage is modestly lower than the reported 0.90.
Reference benchmarking (Phase 5) was not run in this completion pass; the refero MCP was not probed.

detail.targets: saturated iris brand tokens (orange-500/600/700, indigo-600/700/800/900) at tolerance 22
detail.note: Elevated by the flash-sale promotional hero and orange promo bands present at capture. A broader run including mid tints (5099d3, 8ac0e3, teals) yields 0.43. Brand color is deliberately and heavily deployed; share is comfortably above the 15% strong-deployment anchor.
A mature, formally named design-token system with dedicated WCAG-safe neutrals — yet the WCAG-safe tokens are not consistently used in captured roles (see contrast failures).

detail.secondaryBucket: generic-learn-more (5 distinct labels to 5 destinations: 'Learn more' x5, 'Tell me more', 'View details', 'See what's included', 'See if you qualify')

detail.issue: Semantic heading level is decoupled from size: h5 (29px) renders larger than h3/h4 (18-21px) on card grids; h2 appears at both 41px and 29px; the PDP introduces its own sizes (57/34/32/28). No clean modular ratio.

detail.note: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratios computed from captured iris colors in their actual UI roles. Normal-text AA = 4.5, large-text AA = 3.0, AAA = 7.0.

pairs.role: PRIMARY CTA button label (white on orange-600), 9x on home
button: black text on dark-blue (indigo-800-ish), radius 19.5px, multi-page
white text on light-blue section bg (indigo-500)
body text on pale-blue section (FAQ bg, 29x)
light text on blue reversed section (indigo-700)
SECONDARY CTA button label (white on indigo-700)

detail.remediation: White text reaches AA on orange only at orange-800 (#df1400, 4.96:1); orange-700 (#e84300) is 4.01, still short. Body/brand-blue pairs already pass AAA. The defined --iris-color-neutral-wcag45 (#6d7588) computes 4.62:1 and should replace #848c9d for muted text.

detail.byPage: exam 4 generic + subscriptions 4 generic; all others 0 empty/0 generic per probe
detail.caveat: Zero empty alt is a genuine strength. However the home page JSON shows several 'media image' and 'callout image' alts (carousel + betterway callout) that the probe's generic heuristic did not flag, so effective meaningful-alt is modestly lower than 0.90.

detail.note: Lab TBT is a proxy for INP; PSI field data unavailable (not probed). Several mobile runs returned HTTP 403 (PerimeterX bot-challenge stubs: 13 resources / 22 DOM nodes) and were excluded. The Yottaa front-end optimizer + Adobe Launch tag chain + PerimeterX challenge likely inflate mobile LCP/TBT; the measured values classify poor regardless and represent a real full-load render.

detail.duplicate: '1-800 Contacts | Order Contact Lenses Online' shared by / and /buy-contacts (which returns 200 but finalUrl redirects to /). og:title/description also identical.

detail.pdp: 4 in DOM / 3 visible (three competing visible h1s)
detail.faq: 3 in DOM / 0 visible (no visible h1 at all)
detail.headingSkips: home outline runs h1 -> h2 -> h5 (skips h3/h4)

detail.present: role=banner and role=main on all pages; <main> element on PDP only
detail.missingEverywhere: no <nav>/role=navigation, no <footer>/role=contentinfo on any captured page; <main> element absent (role-only) on most

detail.absent: no JSON-LD on /subscriptions, /glasses, /coupon; no Organization schema anywhere; PDP Product lacks detectable Offer/price/AggregateRating; no BreadcrumbList

detail.present: og:title, og:description, og:url on all pages
detail.missing: og:image null on home + all landing pages (PDP has only a generic contacts-icon.png); og:type null on every page

httpsCanonical.detail: HTTPS enforced on all pages; self-referential canonical present on every captured page (minor: /buy-contacts canonical is /buy-contacts while its finalUrl redirects to /). No meta robots noindex.

llmsTxt.detail: GET /llms.txt returned HTTP 403 (PerimeterX) with text/html — no llms.txt served.

detail.note: Marketing/FAQ pages are content-rich; the PDP template (largest indexable set, ~373 pages) is thin at 117 words and truncates its product description.

detail.basis: Roughly 40% of h2/h3 map to askable topics ('How to order', 'How it works', FAQ questions, 'ExpressExam vs. the doctor's office'); the remainder are slogans/puns ('Huzzah for happy customers!', 'FAQs: Freakin' Awesome Questions', 'Best. Contacts. Subscription. Ever.', 'Yeah, we just busted out a huzzah').

keyFactsCrawlable.detail: What-it-is / who-it's-for / offers are in crawlable text on marketing pages. Per-lens PRICE is locked in the JS pack-size/quantity selector widget and not stated as crawlable text on the PDP; an answer engine cannot cite 'what does ACUVUE OASYS cost here'.

findings.title: Mobile Core Web Vitals all classify POOR

evidence.observed: mobile LCP 16.56s, CLS 0.382, TBT 1363ms, FCP 8.70s (home-mobile-v2, full 198-resource load); desktop LCP 3.11s needs-improvement

findings.businessImpact: Mobile is the majority of e-commerce traffic; a 16.6s LCP and 0.38 layout shift lose visitors before the buy path even paints and depress paid-search Quality Score and conversion.
findings.fix: The EDS migration is the lever: ship a static, server-rendered hero with explicit image dimensions (kills CLS), move the Adobe Launch tag chain + Yottaa + PerimeterX challenge off the critical path (defer/async), preload the one LCP image, and consolidate to a single first-party font. Re-measure with PSI field data post-cutover.

findings.title: Primary CTA (white on orange) fails WCAG AA for its button label

evidence.observed: white #ffffff on orange-600 #f36b00 = 3.04:1 (AA normal needs 4.5); this is the most-used button, 9x on the home page

findings.businessImpact: Low-vision users cannot reliably read the site's primary buy action, directly costing conversions and creating ADA exposure for a brand that publishes an /accessibility page.
findings.fix: White text reaches AA on orange only at orange-800 (#df1400, 4.96:1); reserve orange-600 for large/bold labels (meets AA-large 3:1) or switch the text-bearing primary button to indigo-700 (#0013a2, 13:1). Adopt the already-defined WCAG-safe iris tokens as the button contract.

findings.title: PDP template (~373 pages) ships brand-only titles and boilerplate descriptions

evidence.observed: lens/acuvue-oasys title = '1-800 Contacts' (14 chars, no product term); meta description is generic brand boilerplate

findings.businessImpact: The largest indexable template cannot rank for its own product queries ('acuvue oasys contacts'); 373 pages present identical, value-free titles and forfeit high-intent organic traffic.
findings.fix: Templated intent-bearing titles ('ACUVUE OASYS with HYDRACLEAR PLUS Contact Lenses | 1-800 Contacts') and product-specific meta descriptions sourced from the ButterCMS/product data at build time.

findings.title: Broken H1 structure site-wide

evidence.observed: home 11 h1 in DOM / 1 visible; PDP 3 visible h1; FAQ 0 visible h1; heading outline skips h1 -> h2 -> h5

findings.businessImpact: Search engines and screen readers get an incoherent document outline; the FAQ page has no h1 at all and the PDP has three competing h1s.
findings.fix: Exactly one h1 per page carrying the page's value term; sequential heading levels (no h3/h4 skips). EDS section templates enforce this by construction.

findings.title: Duplicate title and Open Graph across / and /buy-contacts

evidence.observed: '1-800 Contacts | Order Contact Lenses Online' on both; /buy-contacts returns 200 but finalUrl redirects to /, yet canonical says /buy-contacts

findings.businessImpact: Two URLs compete for the same query and split signals; the redirect/canonical mismatch muddies indexation.
findings.fix: Give /buy-contacts a distinct intent-bearing title or consolidate it to / with a clean canonical/redirect.

findings.title: Incomplete landmark set on every page

evidence.observed: no <nav>/role=navigation and no <footer>/role=contentinfo on any captured page; <main> element (not just role) absent on most

findings.businessImpact: Screen-reader users cannot jump to navigation or footer; assistive-tech landmark navigation is degraded across the whole site.
findings.fix: Emit semantic <nav>, <main>, and <footer> landmarks in the EDS template shell (these come for free from EDS block scaffolding).

findings.title: Structured-data gaps: no Organization, missing on 3 pages, thin Product

evidence.observed: no JSON-LD on /subscriptions, /glasses, /coupon; no Organization schema anywhere; PDP Product lacks Offer/price/AggregateRating; no llms.txt (llms.txt 403)

findings.businessImpact: Answer engines can't build a confident entity graph for the brand or cite product price/ratings, weakening AI-search representation.
findings.fix: Add Organization + BreadcrumbList site-wide, complete Product with Offer + AggregateRating on the PDP template, JSON-LD on the three bare pages, and publish an llms.txt.

findings.title: Open Graph image and type missing site-wide

evidence.observed: og:image null on home + all landing pages; og:type null on every page (PDP has only a generic contacts-icon.png)

findings.businessImpact: Links shared to social, messaging, and chat surfaces render without a preview image, depressing click-through on every shared URL.
findings.fix: Per-page og:image (product image on PDPs, offer art on landings) and correct og:type (website/product/article).

findings.title: CTA label vocabulary is fragmented

evidence.observed: order-entry action carries 4 distinct labels (Get started / First time here / Contact lenses / Back again); secondary CTAs use 'Learn more' 5x to 5 different destinations

findings.businessImpact: Repeated, ambiguous labels make the next step unclear and 'Learn more' x5 is both a scannability and an accessibility (content-free link) problem.
findings.fix: One canonical primary verb ('Shop contacts') with clear primary/secondary hierarchy; replace generic 'Learn more' with destination-descriptive labels.

findings.title: Additional text/background contrast failures in real roles

evidence.observed: black-on-dark-blue button 1.65:1; light-blue #8ac0e3 text 1.96:1; orange-on-pale-blue 2.61:1; orange-on-white 3.04:1; white-on-#5099d3 3.07:1; teal #00a08b 3.28:1; muted gray #848c9d 3.38:1 (8 pairs fail AA normal)

findings.businessImpact: Muted labels, teal PDP accents, and light-blue text are unreadable for low-vision users despite a WCAG-safe token existing in the system.
findings.fix: Swap #848c9d muted text for the defined --iris-color-neutral-wcag45 (#6d7588, 4.62:1); darken teal/orange text roles; never place black text on indigo-800. Lint the token-to-role mapping against 4.5:1.

findings.title: PDP content thin and price locked in a JS widget

evidence.observed: PDP = 117 prose words (truncated description); per-lens price lives only in the pack-size/quantity selector widget, not crawlable text

findings.businessImpact: The highest-volume indexable template can't be cited by answer engines for 'what does this lens cost' and gives search little to index.
findings.fix: Render the full product description, spec table, and a starting-price/price-range as crawlable text on the PDP template.

findings.title: Border-radius sprawl

evidence.observed: 12 distinct radius values (4/5/6/8/10/11/12/16/19.5/24/30/32) plus 50% and compound corners

findings.businessImpact: Inconsistent corner vocabulary reads as multiple design eras stitched together and undercuts an otherwise strong token system.
findings.fix: Consolidate to a 3-step radius scale (pill 30, card 16, control 8) as iris tokens and retire the one-offs.

findings.title: Heading size decoupled from semantic level

evidence.observed: h5 (29px) renders larger than h3/h4 (18-21px) on card grids; h2 appears at both 41px and 29px; PDP adds 57/34/32/28px

findings.businessImpact: The visual hierarchy contradicts the document structure, weakening scannability and reinforcing the H1 problems.
findings.fix: Bind each heading level to one size via the type scale; use a single modular ratio across templates.

findings.title: Hero leads with a temporal promo instead of a durable value proposition

evidence.observed: H1 = 'Flash sale: 30% off your first order today' with a promo countdown pattern

findings.businessImpact: The page's strongest slot and its H1 carry a dated, expiring offer rather than the brand's durable 'best price + free shipping' promise, hurting both evergreen SEO and first-impression clarity.
findings.fix: Lead the hero with a durable value-prop H1 and demote the flash-sale/countdown to a secondary promo band.

benchmarks.reason: Reference benchmarking (Phase 5) not run in the report-completion pass; refero MCP not probed.

upliftDirections.pitch: Tomorrow's version of the site you have today.
upliftDirections.summary: Same IA and playful voice, the P1/P2 findings fixed on EDS: static mobile-fast hero with reserved dimensions (F-001), AA-safe primary CTA via iris WCAG tokens (F-002, F-010), templated PDP titles + Product schema (F-003, F-007, F-011), one h1 per page with a full landmark set (F-004, F-006), and unified CTA vocabulary (F-009).

upliftDirections.pitch: What if the iris design system became the product surface?
upliftDirections.summary: Amplify the captured-but-underexploited strength: a formally named token system with dedicated WCAG-safe neutrals and a distinctive display face (GTWalsheim). Make it fully consistent and accessible - one radius scale, level-bound type, brand color deployed with intent - so the friendly '1-800' voice rides a rigorous, coherent system.

upliftDirections.pitch: What if ordering felt like a guided ritual?
upliftDirections.summary: Same IA as A; render the '3 easy steps' / pack-size / prescription flow as progressive, reduced-motion-respecting reveals so motion carries the ordering ritual rather than decoration.
